description:
You are an energy auditor preparing a building energy certification submittal for the 4StoreyBuilding. Two distinct energy conservation measures (ECMs) have been approved by the building owner and must be modeled in the annual energy simulation:

ECM 1 — Zone Thermostat Reset for Middle Floor:
Occupancy analysis shows the Middle Floor (M.*) spaces have lower internal heat gain density than other floors. To avoid unnecessary cooling energy while maintaining ASHRAE Standard 55 thermal comfort, implement a thermostat reset for all conditioned Middle Floor zones:
- Raise the design cooling setpoint (DESIGN-COOL-T) from the current 75°F to 76°F for ALL conditioned M.* zones.
- Lower the design heating setpoint (DESIGN-HEAT-T) from the current 72°F to 71°F for ALL conditioned M.* zones.

ECM 2 — High-Reflectance White Roof:
The building roof is due for replacement. Specifying a high-reflectance white membrane (TPO or EPDM white) will significantly reduce solar heat gain. Change the solar absorptance (ABSORPTANCE) of the 'Roof Construction' from the current value to 0.35 (representing a Class A cool roof with solar reflectance ≥0.65).

After implementing both ECMs, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to quantify combined energy savings. Save the project.

No UI navigation instructions are provided. You must locate the Middle Floor zones in the Building Shell/Zone tree and the Roof Construction in the Construction section of eQUEST independently.
